examined_formations.title: CHINA_RESIDENTIAL_PRIVATE_EV_CHARGING_PROPERTY_GRID_APPROVAL_AND_INSTALLATION_HANDOFF
examined_formations.chinese_title: 中国住宅私人充电桩的物业、电网审批与安装交接摩擦
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A Pingdingshan resident submitted a June 2026 government complaint after buying a new-energy vehicle and applying for a private charging meter; the grid site visit found the community power supply had not been transferred to State Grid, while the property refused to provide power citing wiring trouble and construction difficulty.
The resident reported repeated communication with the property rather than a hypothetical future concern: the desired state transition was already an attempted installation.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: China's National Energy Administration reported 23.057 million charging guns by June 2026, including 18.048 million private charging guns, up 50.4% year over year, showing private residential charging is a mass operating infrastructure rather than a niche device category.

The resident already controlled a parking space and had a vehicle plus willingness to install, while the community already possessed electrical infrastructure; the blockage arose from control and site conditions rather than absence of charging technology.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: The resident first used the formal State Grid application route, then sought property cooperation, repeatedly communicated, and finally escalated to the housing authority when the handoff failed.
Current court cases show owners similarly escalate to litigation when properties refuse the installation certificate or cooperation needed to proceed.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: Property cooperation can be legally required, yet a property certificate is only one step; final feasibility still depends on grid/site survey, transformer/load capacity, electrical safety, fire safety, civil-defense constraints and construction.
The flow is therefore partially standardized but crosses multiple independent controllers before electricity can physically reach the parking space.
economic_signal: The owner has already purchased the EV and is willing to fund a private charging installation, while national private-charger deployment proves a large paid installation market.
That spend does not establish a new low-touch routing margin because hardware, electrical construction and utility/property coordination are already part of established local installation flows.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: The property/community controller governs common-area access and cooperation; the grid or local power operator evaluates connection feasibility; licensed installers perform physical electrical work.
Supreme People's Court reference guidance explicitly distinguishes property cooperation from the later technical and safety feasibility judgment by power and other authorities.
Current local governments already use cross-department coordination and complaint handling to resolve property obstruction, so a generic software layer does not acquire the decisive rights.

examined_formations.title: CHINA_POST_DISCHARGE_HOME_NURSING_LICENSED_MEDICAL_DELIVERY_GAP
examined_formations.chinese_title: 中国出院后居家护理的持证医疗交付缺口
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: In a May 2026 Jiangsu report, the family of a 92-year-old home peritoneal-dialysis patient described the old process of driving him to hospital and pushing a wheelchair for periodic tube replacement as very difficult; the family then placed a home-nursing order through the hospital mini-program.
The reported state change is concrete and recurring: the patient remains at home but periodically needs skilled clinical procedures that the family cannot safely self-perform.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The National Healthcare Security Administration stated in April 2026 that people aged 65 and above account for about 15.9% of China's population and that demand for home and doorstep medical services for mobility-limited patients is increasingly urgent.

China now has a standardized home-service fee item, while Jiangsu and other provinces are extending hospital and primary-care capacity into homes through internet-plus-nursing and family-bed programs.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: Families previously spent substantial time transporting frail patients to hospitals or tried home care until professional intervention was needed.
Current hospital programs receive digital orders and dispatch qualified nurses to perform tube maintenance, wound care, blood collection and other bounded procedures in the home.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: The desired flow already exists and is paid/ordered digitally, but the high-value act remains a licensed nurse physically present in the home.

Shenzhen's August 2026 rules state that the service provider must be a qualified physical medical institution and that an information platform may not independently provide internet-plus-nursing service.
economic_signal: National pricing policy now explicitly recognizes a home-service fee and current hospitals accept home-care orders, establishing real money motion rather than an inferred willingness to pay.
The repeatable scheduling layer is not the scarce value unit: regulated clinical delivery, credentialed staff, supplies, risk control and institutional accountability dominate the service.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: Hospitals and qualified physical medical institutions are the legally recognized providers; nurses must be appropriately registered/qualified and services operate under institutional quality and safety controls.
Suzhou already has an internet-plus-nursing implementation framework and is expanding AI/health-assistant support, while hospitals operate their own ordering and dispatch channels.
A neutral software operator may assist discovery, scheduling and records but cannot independently become the clinical delivery rail.

examined_formations.title: SHANGHAI_OFF_PEAK_SHARED_PARKING_TIME_MISMATCH_AND_GOVERNANCE
examined_formations.chinese_title: 上海错峰共享停车的时段错配与治理控制面
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A January 2026 Shanghai government report quotes a resident saying evening parking became much less stressful after a nearby commercial underground garage opened 150 shared spaces; previously he worried every night about finding a space.
A separate 2026 Changning project identifies old residential communities with a nighttime parking shortage next to government/community facilities whose parking spaces are idle at night.
objective_endowment_or_underuse_evidence: The Changning site has 101 parking spaces and explicitly identified nighttime vacancy; after household demand surveying, 50 spaces were opened for off-peak use at 200 yuan per month.
The value gradient is time-based rather than asset-creation based: offices and public facilities have idle nighttime parking while nearby residential communities have evening scarcity.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: Residents sign up for off-peak shared spaces and walk home from nearby facilities rather than continuing to compete for scarce residential spaces.
Properties and local governments conduct demand surveys, set time windows, add access controls and emergency routes, and then operate recurring monthly shared parking.
contradiction_or_partial_flow_evidence: A real complementary flow already exists and repeatedly converts idle nighttime capacity into residential parking access.
The missing edge is not unowned software discovery: each inventory source requires owner/institution permission, security/access design and operating rules before it can join the flow.
Shanghai's public parking platform already supports off-peak shared-parking search/application and payment for eligible resources.
economic_signal: The Changning project charges 200 yuan per month and the Huangpu project opened 150 shared spaces, proving recurring paid use of otherwise idle capacity.
The city platform and participating parking operators already own the digital transaction surface, while the hard expansion work is onboarding new rights-controlled inventory.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: Shanghai's official parking system already provides off-peak shared-parking application, query and payment functions for eligible road/parking resources.
Parking owners, institutions, property operators and local governance bodies decide whether capacity can be opened and under what security/time rules.
The repeatable software layer is therefore already public/platformized; residual growth depends on rights, governance and physical access integration.
